# NFIB

> The National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) is the leading advocacy organization for small business owners, providing policy advocacy, legal support, research, and member benefits across all 50 states.

NFIB represents millions of small business owners through member-driven advocacy, litigation support, and educational resources. The organization leverages its Research Foundation's quarterly Small Business Economic Trends survey and congressional voting tracking to inform legislative priorities and member engagement.

## Key Topics

- Small Business Advocacy
- Legislative Priorities
- Small Business Economic Trends
- Legal Support & Compliance
- ADA Compliance
- Employment Law
- Tax Policy
- Member Benefits
- Congressional Voting Records
- SBET Report

## Organization & Membership

- [About NFIB](https://www.nfib.com/about-nfib): NFIB nonprofit advocacy organization for small business owners across all 50 states
- [Benefits of Membership](https://www.nfib.com/benefits-of-membership): NFIB membership perks: ENGAGE app, legal support, networking, discounts
- [Member Ballot](https://www.nfib.com/member-ballot): One Member One Vote Ballot program driving NFIB legislative priorities

## Policy & Advocacy

- [Policy Agenda](https://www.nfib.com/policy-agenda): NFIB member-driven policy positions on taxes, healthcare, labor, energy
- [Take Action on Elections](https://www.nfib.com/take-action-elections): NFIB election resources, voter guides, NFIB PAC endorsements, advocacy tools
- [How Congress Voted](https://www.nfib.com/how-congress-voted): NFIB congressional voting record tracker for 117th and 118th Congress
- [Our Victories](https://www.nfib.com/our-victories): NFIB advocacy wins including Section 199A and Section 179 tax victories

## Legal Support & Compliance

- [Legal Support](https://www.nfib.com/legal-support): NFIB Legal Small Business Center: legal guides, ADA compliance, attorney referral
- [Legal Guides](https://www.nfib.com/legal-guides): NFIB legal guides on tax reduction, ADA compliance, employment law
- [Legal Cases](https://www.nfib.com/legal-cases): NFIB Small Business Legal Center amicus briefs and litigation cases index
- [Workplace Posters](https://www.nfib.com/workplace-posters): Free federal workplace posters for NFIB members: OSHA, labor law compliance

## Research & Economic Data

- [Small Business Trends & Research](https://www.nfib.com/small-business-trends-research): NFIB Research Foundation SBET quarterly survey data since 1973
- [SBET Report](https://nfib.com/sbet): NFIB quarterly Small Business Economic Trends report with optimism index
- [Jobs Report](https://nfib.com/news-article/monthly_report/jobs-report): NFIB monthly Small Business Employment Index and economic trends data

## HR & Business Resources

- [Human Resources](https://www.nfib.com/human-resources): NFIB HR resources: interview templates, workplace posters, compliance guides
- [Webinars](https://www.nfib.com/webinars): NFIB webinars on taxes, finance, healthcare, employment law for small business

## News & Education

- [News](https://www.nfib.com/news): NFIB news releases and press releases on policy, regulatory issues by state
- [Small Business Rundown Podcast](https://www.nfib.com/podcasts-small-business-rundown): NFIB podcast covering policy news from Washington D.C. and state capitals
